request.description: Search autocomplete / suggestions. Returns grouped results across cocktails (Cocktail_ID + Cocktail_Title), ingredients (Ingredient_ID + Ingredient), and categories. Optional `limit` param (default 5).

response.name: getSuggestions - 200 OK

request.description:
Multi-filter search across cocktails.

**Filters (all optional):**
- `query` — partial text match on cocktail title
- `category` — exact category match
- `includeIngredients` — array of ingredient names; cocktail must contain ALL (AND logic)
- `excludeIngredients` — array of ingredient names; cocktail must contain NONE
- `minRating` — minimum rating (0–5)
- `maxTotalTime` — max total time in minutes
- `servingsMin` / `servingsMax` — serving count range
- `nutrition` — object with nutrition field names as keys, each with optional `min`/`max` (e.g. `{"Calories": {"min": 100, "max": 300}}`). Supported fields: Calories, Carbohydrates, Protein, Fat, Sugar, Sodium, Cholesterol, Potassium, Calcium, Iron, Saturated Fat, Polyunsaturated Fat, Monounsaturated Fat, Vitamin A, Vitamin C

**Sort options:** `rating_desc`, `rating_asc`, `title_asc`, `title_desc`, `votes_desc`, `votes_asc`, or `<nutrition_field>_asc/desc` (e.g. `calories_asc`, `saturated_fat_desc`)

**Response:** Array of `{ Cocktail_ID, Cocktail_Title, Image_ID }` with pagination.

response.name: advancedSearch - 200 OK

request.description:
Multi-field nutrition range search. Filters cocktails by one or more nutrition fields simultaneously (AND logic across all fields).

**filters** — object where keys are nutrition field names (with spaces, exactly as stored in DB) and values are `{ min?, max? }` range objects.

**Supported field names:** Calories, Carbohydrates, Protein, Fat, Sugar, Sodium, Cholesterol, Potassium, Calcium, Iron, Saturated Fat, Polyunsaturated Fat, Monounsaturated Fat, Vitamin A, Vitamin C

**Sort:** `<field>_asc` or `<field>_desc` using underscores for spaces (e.g. `calories_asc`, `saturated_fat_desc`, `vitamin_c_asc`)

**Response:** Only the filtered nutrition fields are returned per cocktail, plus `Cocktail_ID` and `Cocktail_Title`.

response.name: nutritionSearch - 200 OK
